Project Overview
Overview
Full-Frame Window Replacement · 11 Openings

We measured 11 window openings, working clockwise around the house from the back door. Every one is planned as a full-frame replacement: the whole old window comes out, frame included, and a complete new unit goes into the opening. That's different from an insert, which slips a new window inside the old frame.

Remove the existing windows, frames included
Install new windows sized to each existing opening
Five sliding windows change to two-wide units (playroom and bedrooms)
Insulate, flash, and seal every opening
Haul away the old windows and job debris

What Happens Next
Next Steps
Here's Where We Go From Here

A few selections are still needed before we can finalize the estimate. Here's the process from here.

1
Pick the window line and finishes: exterior color, interior finish, hardware, and screens.
2
Choose the style for the five new two-wide windows (casement or awning). We'll make a recommendation.
3
Decide whether the full bath window gets privacy glass.
4
Oak Creek requires a building permit only when framing changes are needed to fit new windows. These are same-size replacements, so we don't expect one. We'll confirm with the city before work starts.
5
We price everything and send you a written estimate. Once you approve it, we order the windows and schedule installation when they arrive.
